# SupervisedHebbianLearning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A learning rule that combines Hebbian plasticity (co-activation-based weight updates) with error-driven supervisory signals to guide weight modifications. Bridges unsupervised and supervised paradigms, allowing neuromorphic systems to perform task-specific learning while maintaining local, energy-efficient update rules.
